{"id":1981126054,"question_id":4139,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months","timestamp":1776445677,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"120 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1981126054/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Absolute Distance Between Mirror Pairs","memory":"131.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int reversefxn(int x)\n    {\n        int rev = 0;\n        while(x > 0)\n        {\n            rev = rev * 10 + x % 10;\n            x /= 10;\n        }\n        return rev;\n    }\n\n    int minMirrorPairDistance(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n        int ans = INT_MAX;\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(mp.count(nums[i])) ans = min(ans , i - mp[nums[i]]);\n            int reverse = reversefxn(nums[i]);\n            mp[reverse] = i;\n        }\n        return ans == INT_MAX ? -1 : ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-absolute-distance-between-mirror-pairs","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1926}
